text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - The Egyptian government bought 110,000 tonnes of Australian hard wheat. One shipment of 55,000 tonnes is slated for shipment February 10 to 28, and 55,000 tonnes is set for shipment March 1 to 15.
WHEAT TENDERS - India will tender for 50,000 tonnes of wheat by the end of March. The tender closes January 29.
- Jordan will tender February 5 for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat or equivalent origin for shipment by March 31, traders said. U.S. wheat would be under the GSM 102 program.
WHEAT TENDERS - Results awaited on Bangladesh's tender for 100,000 tonnes U.S. No.2 wheat or Australian or Canadian winter red/spring wheat for shipment by February 21, traders said.
- Lebanon's economy ministry plans to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat later this month, the government said.
CORN TENDER - News was awaited on South Africa's Maize Board's tender for 15,000 tonnes of yellow maize for either export or domestic use. The offer was seen closing January 16.
BARLEY TENDERS - Turkey will tender on February 3 to export 150,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley for shipment in February and March, traders said.

BARLEY TENDER - News was awaited on Iran's plans to tender on January 27 to import 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley, European grain traders said on Friday. The barley is for shipment in April.
RICE TENDERS - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organization for Chemicals and Foodstuffs is seeking to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for March shipment. Results would be February 3.

- Iraq will tender will tender on February 3 for 30,000 tonnes of U.S. long grain rice under Iraq's "food-for-oil" program, U.S. exporters said. The tender is for two equal 15,000 tonne positions for April and May delivery.

SOYBEAN TENDERS - South Korea's state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp invited tenders for 40,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 1 soybeans on January 29. Shipment of one 20,000 purchase will be for January 30 to February 18 from the U.S. Gulf or from February 14 to March 5 from the U.S. Pacific Northwest. Shipment of the other 20,000 tonnes will be from the U.S. Gulf between February 24 and March 15 or from PNW March 11 to 30.

- The Taiwan Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association will tender for 54,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans on Tuesday. The shipment is slated for delivery March 1-15 from the U.S. Gulf or March 16-31 from the Pacific Northwest.

SOYMEAL/RAPESEED TENDER - South Korea's KFA will tender for 44,500 tonnes of soymeal and 4,500 tonnes of rapemeal Tuesday. The tender was divided into three positions. The first, for 23,000 tonnes of soymeal, is set for arrival April 20. The second of 13,000 tonnes of soymeal is slated for April 10 arrival, and the third for 8,500 soymeal and 4,500 rapemeal is set for arrival April 10.
PALM STEARIN TENDER - Egypt's state Food Industries Co said it sought 10,000 tonnes of Malaysian or Indonesian palm stearin for March delivery. The tender will close 1000 GMT on February 12.
MARKET TALK - China has become a major world corn producer, with production exceeding 100 million tonnes in 1996, or one-fifth of the world's total production, the Xinhua Daily Telegraph said.
- After China's recent re-entry into the world corn market, its prices have yet to fall low enough to tempt Japanese buyers, traders said.
- Ukraine's all-important winter grain crop is weathering the cold better than it did last year, but the risk of damage still exists, a government official said.
